description: This file defines a singleton object Validation containing validation functions for email, password, and password confirmation, commonly used in form validation within a Kotlin frontend application.

methods.name: emailError
methods.description: Validates an email string, returning an error message if invalid or null if valid.

methods.name: passwordError
methods.description: Validates a password string, returning an error message if invalid or null if valid.

methods.name: confirmPasswordError
methods.description: Checks if confirm password matches the original password, returning an error message if invalid or null if valid.
